notes: Flip gate for the Pact dependency declaration pass (`Frontend::add_dependency`
and the validation over the dependencies' traits, `probe_deps_declarations`),
ported in @vesper/check-pact and installed as the hybrid's `deps_pass` swap
(crates/vesper-hybrid/src/swap/pact.rs). A compiler module: its Rust goes at the
Rust compiler's retirement. The `deps-pass-swap-path` workload times Rust against
the swap's path (each dependency's world collected, encode_deps_input, the Vesper
pass, decode) over the dependency cases, 200 rounds a side.
name: pact-deps
